mapper.select: SELECT FACTORY_CODE, YEAR, MONTH, MONTH_PLAN_VERSION, LAST_MONTH_PLAN_VERSION, PRODUCTION_VERSION FROM T_MP_MONTH_PLAN_PROD_FINAL WHERE IS_DELETE = 0 AND PRODUCTION_VERSION IS NOT NULL AND MONTH_PLAN_VERSION IS NOT NULL AND LAST_MONTH_PLAN_VERSION IS NOT NULL AND PRODUCTION_VERSION != '' AND MONTH_PLAN_VERSION != '' AND LAST_MONTH_PLAN_VERSION != '' AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND YEAR = #{year} AND MONTH = #{month} GROUP BY FACTORY_CODE, YEAR, MONTH, MONTH_PLAN_VERSION, LAST_MONTH_PLAN_VERSION, PRODUCTION_VERSION

SELECT fin.ID, fin.PRODUCTION_NO, fin.FACTORY_CODE, fin.YEAR, fin.MONTH, fin.YEAR_MONTH, fin.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION, IFNULL(fin.LAST_MONTH_PLAN_VERSION, fin.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION) AS LAST_MONTH_PLAN_VERSION, fin.PRODUCTION_VERSION, fin.PRODUCT_TYPE_CODE, fin.MATERIAL_CODE, fin.MATERIAL_DESC, fin.MES_MATERIAL_CODE, fin.STRUCTURE_NAME, fin.PRO_SIZE, fin.PRODUCT_CATEGORY, fin.PRODUCT_STATUS, fin.STRUCTURE_TYPE, fin.PRODUCTION_TYPE, fin.EMBRYO_CODE, fin.MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC, fin.CONSTRUCTION_STAGE, fin.IS_ZERO_RACK, fin.EMBRYO_NO, fin.LH_NO, fin.TEXT_NO, fin.BRAND, fin.SPECIFICATIONS, fin.MAIN_PATTERN, fin.PATTERN, fin.MOULD_CAVITY_QTY, fin.TYPE_BLOCK_QTY, fin.DYNAMIC_BALANCE_QTY, fin.UNIFORMITY_QTY, fin.AVERAGE_SALE_QTY, fin.INVENTORY_SALES_RATIO, fin.DAY_VULCANIZATION_QTY, fin.CX_MACHINE_CODE, fin.MOULD_CHANGE_INFO, fin.IS_IMPORT, fin.PRODUCTION_SEQUENCE, fin.CURING_TIME, fin.PROD_REQ_PLAN, fin.TRIAL_QTY, fin.FACT_PROD_REQ_QTY, fin.TOTAL_QTY, fin.HEIGHT_PRODUCTION_QTY, fin.MID_PRODUCTION_QTY, fin.CYCLE_PRODUCTION_QTY, fin.CONVENTION_PRODUCTION_QTY, fin.POSTPONE_PRODUCTION_QTY, fin.TRIAL_PRODUCTION_QTY, fin.DIFFERENCE_QTY, fin.ORIGINAL_TOTAL_QTY, fin.REASON, fin.BEGIN_DAY, fin.END_DAY, fin.DAY_1, fin.DAY_2, fin.DAY_3, fin.DAY_4, fin.DAY_5, fin.DAY_6, fin.DAY_7, fin.DAY_8, fin.DAY_9, fin.DAY_10, fin.DAY_11, fin.DAY_12, fin.DAY_13, fin.DAY_14, fin.DAY_15, fin.DAY_16, fin.DAY_17, fin.DAY_18, fin.DAY_19, fin.DAY_20, fin.DAY_21, fin.DAY_22, fin.DAY_23, fin.DAY_24, fin.DAY_25, fin.DAY_26, fin.DAY_27, fin.DAY_28, fin.DAY_29, fin.DAY_30, fin.DAY_31, fin.TOTAL_VULCANIZATION_MINUTES, fin.DISPLAY_SEQ, fin.LAST_MONTH_OVERDUE_QTY, fin.LAST_MONTH_VALID_FLAG, fin.IS_RELEASE, fin.REMARK, fin.IS_DELETE, fin.CREATE_TIME, fin.UPDATE_TIME, fin.CREATE_BY, fin.UPDATE_BY, fin.LAST_MONTH_OVERDUE_QTY, fin.LAST_MONTH_VALID_FLAG, NULLIF(fin.ADJUST_QTY1, 0) AS ADJUST_QTY1, NULLIF(fin.ADJUST_QTY2, 0) AS ADJUST_QTY2, NULLIF(fin.ADJUST_QTY3, 0) AS ADJUST_QTY3, NULLIF(fin.ADJUST_QTY4, 0) AS ADJUST_QTY4, ddps.NET_QTY, ddps.HEIGHT_QTY, ddps.MID_QTY, ddps.CYCLE_RESERVE_QTY, ddps.CONVENTION_RESERVE_QTY, ddps.POSTPONE_QTY
FROM T_MP_MONTH_PLAN_PROD_FINAL fin
LEFT JOIN T_DP_DEMAND_PLAN_SUM ddps ON fin.FACTORY_CODE = ddps.FACTORY_CODE AND fin.`YEAR` = ddps.`YEAR` AND fin.`MONTH` = ddps.`MONTH` AND fin.MATERIAL_CODE = ddps.MATERIAL_CODE AND IFNULL(fin.LAST_MONTH_PLAN_VERSION, fin.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION) = ddps.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION AND ddps.IS_DELETE = 0
WHERE fin.IS_DELETE = 0 AND fin.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND fin.`YEAR` = #{year} AND fin.`MONTH` = #{month} AND fin.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION = #{monthPlanVersion} AND fin.PRODUCTION_VERSION = #{productionVersion} AND fin.PRODUCT_TYPE_CODE = #{productTypeCode} AND fin.CONSTRUCTION_STAGE = #{constructionStage} AND fin.BRAND = #{brand} AND fin.PRO_SIZE = #{proSize} AND fin.MATERIAL_CODE like CONCAT('%', #{materialCode}, '%') AND fin.MATERIAL_DESC like CONCAT('%', #{materialDesc}, '%') AND fin.MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC like CONCAT('%', #{mainMaterialDesc}, '%') AND fin.SPECIFICATIONS like CONCAT('%', #{specifications}, '%') AND fin.MAIN_PATTERN like CONCAT('%', #{mainPattern}, '%') AND fin.PATTERN like CONCAT('%', #{pattern}, '%') AND fin.STRUCTURE_NAME like CONCAT('%', #{structureName}, '%') AND fin.CX_MACHINE_CODE like CONCAT('%', #{cxMachineCode}, '%') AND IFNULL(fin.LAST_MONTH_PLAN_VERSION, fin.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION) like CONCAT('%', #{lastMonthPlanVersion}, '%')
mapper.update: UPDATE T_MP_MONTH_PLAN_PROD_FINAL f LEFT JOIN ( SELECT f5.FACTORY_CODE, f5.MATERIAL_CODE, IFNULL(f5.TOTAL_QTY, 0) - IFNULL(fin.FINISH_QTY, 0) AS OVERDUE_QTY FROM T_MP_MONTH_PLAN_PROD_FINAL f5 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT FACTORY_CODE, MATERIAL_CODE, IFNULL(SUM(DAY_FINISH_QTY), 0) AS FINISH_QTY FROM T_LH_DAY_FINISH_QTY WHERE FINISH_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND IS_DELETE = 0 GROUP BY FACTORY_CODE, MATERIAL_CODE ) fin ON f5.FACTORY_CODE = fin.FACTORY_CODE AND f5.MATERIAL_CODE = fin.MATERIAL_CODE WHERE f5.IS_DELETE = 0 AND f5.YEAR = #{lastYear} AND f5.MONTH = #{lastMonth} ) calc ON f.FACTORY_CODE = calc.FACTORY_CODE AND f.MATERIAL_CODE = calc.MATERIAL_CODE SET f.LAST_MONTH_OVERDUE_QTY = calc.OVERDUE_QTY, f.LAST_MONTH_VALID_FLAG = CASE WHEN calc.OVERDUE_QTY IS NOT NULL THEN '1' ELSE '0' END, f.UPDATE_TIME = NOW() WHERE f.IS_DELETE = 0 AND f.YEAR = #{currentYear} AND f.MONTH = #{currentMonth}
